content.text: The queue indicator comes from a controller-side listener, so it can also refresh running builds once a minute. I’ll use [Jenkins’ duration estimate](https://javadoc.jenkins.io/hudson/model/Run.html#getEstimatedDuration()) for a status like `Running: started 29 m ago; ~21%; est. remaining 1 hr 50 m`, with explicit messages when no estimate is available or the run exceeds it. I’m also using the testing-and-verification skill to check the status transitions.
